cases.task: Choose the safe transactional policy when an operator manually reconnects while a bounded SSE recovery timer is pending, and when the timer later attempts to construct its fresh EventSource.

required_facts.text: Invalid manual input or synchronous candidate construction failure must not cancel a still-viable pending recovery timer or reset its retry budget.
A manual candidate may cancel the pending timer and reset the budget only after its EventSource construction succeeds.
If the fired retry itself cannot construct a fresh EventSource, no timer remains and the failure must be terminal, visible, and require manual reconnect.
